background-remover.name: Background remover (color)
background-remover.description: Make a solid or near-solid background transparent by color, with tolerance and soft edges, locally.
background-remover.keywords: background, remove, transparent, chroma, chroma key, cutout, png, color key
background-remover.pickLabel: Drop an image here (solid backgrounds work best)
background-remover.tip: Tip: click the original to pick the background color.

barcode-generator.name: Barcode generator
barcode-generator.description: Generate barcodes (Code128, EAN, UPC, Code39 and more) from text, locally.
barcode-generator.keywords: barcode, code128, ean, upc, code39, generator, svg, png
barcode-generator.tip: Tip: EAN-13 needs 12 or 13 digits, UPC needs 11 or 12, EAN-8 needs 7 or 8. CODE128 accepts any text.

base64-image.name: Base64 image viewer
base64-image.description: Preview a Base64 or data URI image, or turn an image into a Base64 data URI, locally.
base64-image.keywords: base64, image, data uri, preview, encode, decode, inline
base64-image.placeholder: Paste a data URI or Base64 image string…

errors.notImage: This data URI is not an image.
errors.notBase64: Input is not a data URI or valid Base64.

image-compressor.name: Image compressor
image-compressor.description: Resize and compress images to JPEG, WebP or PNG in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
image-compressor.keywords: image, photo, compress, resize, optimize, shrink, jpeg, webp, png

qr-generator.name: QR code generator
qr-generator.description: Generate a QR code from text or a URL, with color and error correction options, locally.
qr-generator.keywords: qr, qr code, generator, url, link, barcode, png, svg
qr-generator.placeholder: Enter text or a URL to encode…
qr-generator.failed: Could not generate the QR code. The text may be too long.

svg-placeholder.name: SVG placeholder generator
svg-placeholder.description: Generate lightweight placeholder images as inline SVG or a data URI, locally.
svg-placeholder.keywords: svg, placeholder, image, mock, dummy, data uri, generator

wifi-qr.name: Wi-Fi QR code generator
wifi-qr.description: Create a QR code that connects devices to a Wi-Fi network, locally.
wifi-qr.keywords: wifi, wi-fi, qr, code, network, password, ssid, connect, generator
